card.name: Unit mg after a small starting dose
card.fires_on: The unit mg (or the digits and decimal point just before it) right after a small dose number, usually in starting-dose or per-kg dosing sentences.

modes.label: mg after dose number
modes.description: The word mg directly after a small number in a starting or per-kg dose.
modes.example: the recommended starting dose of metoprolol succinate extended-release is 1.0<< mg>>/kg once daily

modes.label: Inside the dose number
modes.description: A decimal point or digit within a small dose such as 2.5 or 12.5, just before mg.
modes.example: Children - A dose of 2.<<5>> mg/kg/day of Imipramine
